# Joel Denaro, P.A.

> Joel M. Denaro is a Miami-based criminal defense trial attorney with more than 25 years of experience representing clients in state and federal courts throughout South Florida and nationwide.

Joel Denaro, P.A. is a criminal defense law firm founded in 2004 by Joel M. Denaro, based in Miami, Florida. The firm represents clients in state and federal courts across South Florida, the Southern and Eastern Districts of New York, and Washington, D.C.

## Practice areas
- DUI and traffic offenses
- Drug charges (state and federal narcotics offenses)
- Violent crime defense
- White-collar and fraud defense
- Federal criminal defense, including RICO, money laundering, and OFAC/FCPA matters
- International extradition proceedings
- Appeals and post-conviction relief

## About the attorney
- Joel M. Denaro — Florida Bar member since 1999; J.D., New York Law School; B.A., Loyola University New Orleans
- Trained at the Miami-Dade Public Defender's Office for 6.5+ years; tried 40+ jury trials to verdict
- Recognized in Best Lawyers in America® since 2008 (Criminal Defense: General Practice & White-Collar)
- Recognized in Best Law Firms® — U.S. News & World Report (Miami, Criminal Defense)
- Member, National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers and Florida Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers
- Admitted: U.S. District Court, Southern District of Florida; U.S. Court of Appeals, Eleventh Circuit

## Languages
The firm serves English- and Spanish-speaking clients; the website is available in both languages.
